tools.name: list_whitepapers

tools.name: get_cip_attachments

tools.name: search_github_issues

tools.name: search_talks
tools.description: Search blobpedia's indexed Celestia talks/videos (YouTube transcripts). Celestia-specific. Returns matches across title + transcript with a short snippet around the hit.

tools.name: search_release_notes
tools.description: Search across release-notes bodies of all indexed Celestia repos for a feature/keyword. Celestia-specific. Use to find which release first mentioned X.

tools.name: find_security_patches
tools.description: Surface release notes likely to contain security or CVE fixes. Celestia-specific. Heuristic: matches release bodies containing security / CVE / vulnerability / patch keywords.

tools.name: find_maintainer_guidance
tools.description: Surface forum posts authored by top-volume Celestia forum contributors (likely maintainers/core team) on a topic. Celestia-specific. Use when you want to weight expert voices over the general forum.

tools.name: get_issue_status
tools.description: Look up one GitHub issue or PR by repo + number. Celestia repos only.

tools.name: find_code_examples
tools.description: Find Celestia code snippets in forum posts on a topic. Filters forum_posts where the rendered HTML contains `<pre>` or `<code>` blocks AND matches the topic keyword. Celestia-specific.

tools.name: find_expert

tools.name: ecosystem_dependency_graph

tools.name: find_collaboration_opportunities

tools.name: diagnose_error

tools.name: find_cip_for_feature

tools.name: get_latest_release
tools.description: Get the single latest release (version tag, publish date, and GitHub release-notes link) for ONE NAMED Celestia repo: app, node, core, rollkit, or openrpc. Celestia-specific. Requires a package name as input.

Filter by level (critical/important/ecosystem/all). Celestia-

tools.name: find_similar_projects
tools.description: Find Celestia ecosystem projects most similar to a free-text description by matching across title + category + description + tags. Celestia-specific. Useful before proposing a project to check overlap with what already exists.

tools.name: detect_drift
tools.description: Find contradictions between docs, forum and GitHub on a topic. Returns counts of how each surface talks about it plus the most recent doc-page and forum statement so the caller can spot mismatches.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, get_cip, list_cips, get_discussion, get_trending, get_cip_history, get_cip_mentions, get_recent_changes, get_network_stats, list_github_discussions, get_github_discussion, get_video, list_videos, semantic_search, search_github_issues, search_talks, get_issue_status, diagnose_error, get_breaking_changes, detect_cip_dependency_chain, find_known_issues, get_radar · Private data: search, get_trending, get_cip_attachments, get_foundation_info, semantic_search · Public sink: get_latest_release.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, get_cip, list_cips, get_discussion, get_trending, get_cip_history, get_cip_mentions, get_recent_changes, get_network_stats, list_github_discussions, get_github_discussion, get_video, list_videos, semantic_search, search_github_issues, search_talks, get_issue_status, diagnose_error, get_breaking_changes, detect_cip_dependency_chain, find_known_issues, get_radar · Private data: search, get_trending, get_cip_attachments, get_foundation_info, semantic_search · Public sink: get_latest_release

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_recent_changes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
